soundness_flags.label: Definitions of A, canonical SI-PAG, and all A-indexed headline statements
soundness_flags.one_line: A is defined using pa_G0(S) although G0 is declared only on V, then used as A(eta) without a model-indexed definition; additionally E_O includes regime skeleton endpoints while P_SI is typed only on V although M_k includes zeta_k.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem confidence-si-pag
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The finite-sample graph conclusion is conditional on the proposed deterministic complete-local-calculus theorem.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-alphabet SI-PAG recovery with probability at least 1-alpha, conditional on Cl_R(O)=P_SI(O).

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CDIS is sound; the authors state that completeness and an equivalence-class graphical representation remain unresolved.
Additional orientation rules make FCI complete under standard assumptions in the presence of latent confounders and selection bias.
The paper states and proves conditions for Markov equivalence of maximal ancestral graphs and a polynomial-time equivalence algorithm.
The algorithm learns the psi-Markov equivalence class for unknown-target soft interventions and is stated to be sound and complete.
The paper gives polynomial-delay MAG listing using recursively introduced singleton background knowledge and sound locally complete rules.
FCI and RFCI consistency is proved in sparse high-dimensional settings with latent and selection variables.
Invariant prediction yields valid confidence intervals for causal relationships under its stated framework.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define a basal graph on V union S, explicitly define A(eta)=An_G( pa_G(S) ) cap V, and make the SI-PAG endpoint domain consistently include or exclude intervention-indicator endpoints.
State a precise reduction theorem for K=0 and A empty that specifies the retained rule schemas and identifies the exact Zhang or unknown-target-interventional closure recovered.
Replace the positivity citation with a source that directly supports finite conditional-table positivity, and state whether p_min ranges over both regimes in every invariance query.

recommended_next_step: Repair the graph and endpoint-domain typing, then advance the field-tier common-basal completeness kernel to Stage 0.
